title: 巴克莱邵炯：阿里腾讯谁是中国版Anthropic？路径不同回报各异
speaker: Jiong Shao

segments.en: Earlier on the program, you were talking about Enthropy IPO, coming up rumored around October. The challenge is that they're aiming for two trillion valuation.
segments.zh: 节目早些时候提到Anthropic可能十月IPO，目标估值两万亿。

segments.en: So ahead of Enthropy IPO, people are thinking about who is the Chinese Enthropic? And in our view, it's either, well, at least the leading candidates are Tencent or Alibaba.
segments.zh: 在Anthropic IPO之前，市场在思考谁是中国版Anthropic？我们认为领先候选是腾讯或阿里。

segments.en: They have made different strategic bets. Alibaba, because of its sort of history in providing cloud services to enterprises throughout China.
segments.zh: 他们做出了不同的战略选择。阿里因其为国内企业提供云服务的历史。

segments.en: So that's very natural for them to be a player in the compute space, which is by a bunch of GPU CPUs and provide that services to your customers.
segments.zh: 所以他们自然成为算力领域的参与者，采购GPU/CPU并向客户提供服务。

segments.en: The Tencent we believe is making a different bet, depending on the enterprise AI aging space.
segments.zh: 我们认为腾讯押注不同的方向，专注于企业级AI代理领域。

segments.en: That's why Workbody, which is the AI agent for enterprises in China from Tencent, is a leading enterprise AI agent in China.
segments.zh: 这就是腾讯的企业AI代理Workbody成为中国领先的企业AI代理的原因。

segments.en: Now, the return profiles will be a little bit different as well. If you're an infrastructure player like Baba, you will get a return almost immediately. That's why you're paying by time in three years.
segments.zh: 回报特征也会不同。像阿里这样的基础设施玩家几乎立即获得回报，这就是三年回本的原因。

segments.en: But the return profile for AI aging for enterprise is much longer, but we actually seeing the Ten-Eventure market size can be a lot bigger down the road.
segments.zh: 但企业AI代理的回报周期更长，然而我们预计其潜在市场规模会大得多。
